FN-F9EFD5D-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 130
Committee: Boards, Agencies, and Commissions Sponsor: Representative Neil Rafferty
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 130as introduced provides for the continuance of the Board of Licensure for
Professional Geologists until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The
provisions of this bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Page 1
